040/**
041 * Singleton class for creating and keeping camera servers. Also publishes camera information to
042 * NetworkTables.
043 */
044public final class CameraServer {
045  /** CameraServer base port. */
046  public static final int BASE_PORT = 1181;
047
048  private static final String PUBLISH_NAME = "/CameraPublisher";
049
050  private static final class PropertyPublisher implements AutoCloseable {
051    @SuppressWarnings("fallthrough")
052    PropertyPublisher(NetworkTable table, VideoEvent event) {
053      String name;
054      String infoName;
055      if (event.name.startsWith("raw_")) {
056        name = "RawProperty/" + event.name;
057        infoName = "RawPropertyInfo/" + event.name;
058      } else {
059        name = "Property/" + event.name;
060        infoName = "PropertyInfo/" + event.name;
061      }
062
063      try {
064        switch (event.propertyKind) {
065          case BOOLEAN:
066            m_booleanValueEntry = table.getBooleanTopic(name).getEntry(false);
067            m_booleanValueEntry.setDefault(event.value != 0);
068            break;
069          case ENUM:
070            m_choicesTopic = table.getStringArrayTopic(infoName + "/choices");
071          // fallthrough
072          case INTEGER:
073            m_integerValueEntry = table.getIntegerTopic(name).getEntry(0);
074            m_minPublisher = table.getIntegerTopic(infoName + "/min").publish();
075            m_maxPublisher = table.getIntegerTopic(infoName + "/max").publish();
076            m_stepPublisher = table.getIntegerTopic(infoName + "/step").publish();
077            m_defaultPublisher = table.getIntegerTopic(infoName + "/default").publish();
078
079            m_integerValueEntry.setDefault(event.value);
080            m_minPublisher.set(CameraServerJNI.getPropertyMin(event.propertyHandle));
081            m_maxPublisher.set(CameraServerJNI.getPropertyMax(event.propertyHandle));
082            m_stepPublisher.set(CameraServerJNI.getPropertyStep(event.propertyHandle));
083            m_defaultPublisher.set(CameraServerJNI.getPropertyDefault(event.propertyHandle));
084            break;
085          case STRING:
086            m_stringValueEntry = table.getStringTopic(name).getEntry("");
087            m_stringValueEntry.setDefault(event.valueStr);
088            break;
089          default:
090            break;
091        }
092      } catch (VideoException ignored) {
093        // ignore
094      }
095    }
096
097    void update(VideoEvent event) {
098      switch (event.propertyKind) {
099        case BOOLEAN -> {
100          if (m_booleanValueEntry != null) {
101            m_booleanValueEntry.set(event.value != 0);
102          }
103        }
104        case INTEGER, ENUM -> {
105          if (m_integerValueEntry != null) {
106            m_integerValueEntry.set(event.value);
107          }
108        }
109        case STRING -> {
110          if (m_stringValueEntry != null) {
111            m_stringValueEntry.set(event.valueStr);
112          }
113        }
114        default -> {
115          // NOP
116        }
117      }
118    }
119
120    @Override
121    public void close() {
122      try {
123        if (m_booleanValueEntry != null) {
124          m_booleanValueEntry.close();
125        }
126        if (m_integerValueEntry != null) {
127          m_integerValueEntry.close();
128        }
129        if (m_stringValueEntry != null) {
130          m_stringValueEntry.close();
131        }
132        if (m_minPublisher != null) {
133          m_minPublisher.close();
134        }
135        if (m_maxPublisher != null) {
136          m_maxPublisher.close();
137        }
138        if (m_stepPublisher != null) {
139          m_stepPublisher.close();
140        }
141        if (m_defaultPublisher != null) {
142          m_defaultPublisher.close();
143        }
144        if (m_choicesPublisher != null) {
145          m_choicesPublisher.close();
146        }
147      } finally {
148        Reference.reachabilityFence(m_videoListener);
149      }
150    }
151
152    BooleanEntry m_booleanValueEntry;
153    IntegerEntry m_integerValueEntry;
154    StringEntry m_stringValueEntry;
155    IntegerPublisher m_minPublisher;
156    IntegerPublisher m_maxPublisher;
157    IntegerPublisher m_stepPublisher;
158    IntegerPublisher m_defaultPublisher;
159    StringArrayTopic m_choicesTopic;
160    StringArrayPublisher m_choicesPublisher;
161  }
162
163  private static final class SourcePublisher implements AutoCloseable {
164    SourcePublisher(NetworkTable table, int sourceHandle) {
165      this.m_table = table;
166      m_sourcePublisher = table.getStringTopic("source").publish();
167      m_descriptionPublisher = table.getStringTopic("description").publish();
168      m_connectedPublisher = table.getBooleanTopic("connected").publish();
169      m_streamsPublisher = table.getStringArrayTopic("streams").publish();
170      m_modeEntry = table.getStringTopic("mode").getEntry("");
171      m_modesPublisher = table.getStringArrayTopic("modes").publish();
172
173      m_sourcePublisher.set(makeSourceValue(sourceHandle));
174      m_descriptionPublisher.set(CameraServerJNI.getSourceDescription(sourceHandle));
175      m_connectedPublisher.set(CameraServerJNI.isSourceConnected(sourceHandle));
176      m_streamsPublisher.set(getSourceStreamValues(sourceHandle));
177
178      try {
179        VideoMode mode = CameraServerJNI.getSourceVideoMode(sourceHandle);
180        m_modeEntry.setDefault(videoModeToString(mode));
181        m_modesPublisher.set(getSourceModeValues(sourceHandle));
182      } catch (VideoException ignored) {
183        // Do nothing. Let the other event handlers update this if there is an error.
184      }
185    }
186
187    @Override
188    public void close() throws Exception {
189      m_sourcePublisher.close();
190      m_descriptionPublisher.close();
191      m_connectedPublisher.close();
192      m_streamsPublisher.close();
193      m_modeEntry.close();
194      m_modesPublisher.close();
195      for (PropertyPublisher pp : m_properties.values()) {
196        pp.close();
197      }
198    }
199
200    final NetworkTable m_table;
201    final StringPublisher m_sourcePublisher;
202    final StringPublisher m_descriptionPublisher;
203    final BooleanPublisher m_connectedPublisher;
204    final StringArrayPublisher m_streamsPublisher;
205    final StringEntry m_modeEntry;
206    final StringArrayPublisher m_modesPublisher;
207    final Map<Integer, PropertyPublisher> m_properties = new HashMap<>();
208  }
209
210  private static final AtomicInteger m_defaultUsbDevice = new AtomicInteger();
211  private static String m_primarySourceName;
212  private static final Map<String, VideoSource> m_sources = new HashMap<>();
213  private static final Map<String, VideoSink> m_sinks = new HashMap<>();
214  private static final Map<Integer, SourcePublisher> m_publishers =
215      new HashMap<>(); // indexed by source handle
216  // source handle indexed by sink handle
217  private static final Map<Integer, Integer> m_fixedSources = new HashMap<>();
218  private static final NetworkTable m_publishTable =
219      NetworkTableInstance.getDefault().getTable(PUBLISH_NAME);
220
221  // We publish sources to NetworkTables using the following structure:
222  // "/CameraPublisher/{Source.Name}/" - root
223  // - "source" (string): Descriptive, prefixed with type (e.g. "usb:0")
224  // - "streams" (string array): URLs that can be used to stream data
225  // - "description" (string): Description of the source
226  // - "connected" (boolean): Whether source is connected
227  // - "mode" (string): Current video mode
228  // - "modes" (string array): Available video modes
229  // - "Property/{Property}" - Property values
230  // - "PropertyInfo/{Property}" - Property supporting information
231
232  // Listener for video events
233  @SuppressWarnings("PMD.AvoidCatchingGenericException")
234  private static final VideoListener m_videoListener =
235      new VideoListener(
236          event -> {
237            synchronized (CameraServer.class) {
238              switch (event.kind) {
239                case SOURCE_CREATED -> {
240                  // Create subtable for the camera
241                  NetworkTable table = m_publishTable.getSubTable(event.name);
242                  m_publishers.put(
243                      event.sourceHandle, new SourcePublisher(table, event.sourceHandle));
244                }
245                case SOURCE_DESTROYED -> {
246                  SourcePublisher publisher = m_publishers.remove(event.sourceHandle);
247                  if (publisher != null) {
248                    try {
249                      publisher.close();
250                    } catch (Exception e) {
251                      // ignore (nothing we can do about it)
252                    }
253                  }
254                }
255                case SOURCE_CONNECTED -> {
256                  SourcePublisher publisher = m_publishers.get(event.sourceHandle);
257                  if (publisher != null) {
258                    // update the description too (as it may have changed)
259                    publisher.m_descriptionPublisher.set(
260                        CameraServerJNI.getSourceDescription(event.sourceHandle));
261                    publisher.m_connectedPublisher.set(true);
262                  }
263                }
264                case SOURCE_DISCONNECTED -> {
265                  SourcePublisher publisher = m_publishers.get(event.sourceHandle);
266                  if (publisher != null) {
267                    publisher.m_connectedPublisher.set(false);
268                  }
269                }
270                case SOURCE_VIDEO_MODES_UPDATED -> {
271                  SourcePublisher publisher = m_publishers.get(event.sourceHandle);
272                  if (publisher != null) {
273                    publisher.m_modesPublisher.set(getSourceModeValues(event.sourceHandle));
274                  }
275                }
276                case SOURCE_VIDEO_MODE_CHANGED -> {
277                  SourcePublisher publisher = m_publishers.get(event.sourceHandle);
278                  if (publisher != null) {
279                    publisher.m_modeEntry.set(videoModeToString(event.mode));
280                  }
281                }
282                case SOURCE_PROPERTY_CREATED -> {
283                  SourcePublisher publisher = m_publishers.get(event.sourceHandle);
284                  if (publisher != null) {
285                    publisher.m_properties.put(
286                        event.propertyHandle, new PropertyPublisher(publisher.m_table, event));
287                  }
288                }
289                case SOURCE_PROPERTY_VALUE_UPDATED -> {
290                  SourcePublisher publisher = m_publishers.get(event.sourceHandle);
291                  if (publisher != null) {
292                    PropertyPublisher pp = publisher.m_properties.get(event.propertyHandle);
293                    if (pp != null) {
294                      pp.update(event);
295                    }
296                  }
297                }
298                case SOURCE_PROPERTY_CHOICES_UPDATED -> {
299                  SourcePublisher publisher = m_publishers.get(event.sourceHandle);
300                  if (publisher != null) {
301                    PropertyPublisher pp = publisher.m_properties.get(event.propertyHandle);
302                    if (pp != null && pp.m_choicesTopic != null) {
303                      try {
304                        String[] choices =
305                            CameraServerJNI.getEnumPropertyChoices(event.propertyHandle);
306                        if (pp.m_choicesPublisher == null) {
307                          pp.m_choicesPublisher = pp.m_choicesTopic.publish();
308                        }
309                        pp.m_choicesPublisher.set(choices);
310                      } catch (VideoException ignored) {
311                        // ignore (just don't publish choices if we can't get them)
312                      }
313                    }
314                  }
315                }
316                case SINK_SOURCE_CHANGED,
317                    SINK_CREATED,
318                    SINK_DESTROYED,
319                    NETWORK_INTERFACES_CHANGED -> {
320                  m_addresses = CameraServerJNI.getNetworkInterfaces();
321                  updateStreamValues();
322                }
323                default -> {
324                  // NOP
325                }
326              }
327            }
328          },
329          0x4fff,
330          true);
331
332  private static int m_nextPort = BASE_PORT;
333  private static String[] m_addresses = new String[0];
334
335  /**
336   * Return URI of source with the given index.
337   *
338   * @param source Source index.
339   */
340  private static String makeSourceValue(int source) {
341    return switch (VideoSource.getKindFromInt(CameraServerJNI.getSourceKind(source))) {
342      case USB -> "usb:" + CameraServerJNI.getUsbCameraPath(source);
343      case HTTP -> {
344        String[] urls = CameraServerJNI.getHttpCameraUrls(source);
345        if (urls.length > 0) {
346          yield "ip:" + urls[0];
347        } else {
348          yield "ip:";
349        }
350      }
351      case CV -> "cv:";
352      case RAW -> "raw:";
353      case UNKNOWN -> "unknown:";
354    };
355  }
356
357  /**
358   * Return URI of stream with the given address and port.
359   *
360   * @param address Stream IP address.
361   * @param port Stream remote port.
362   */
363  private static String makeStreamValue(String address, int port) {
364    return "mjpg:http://" + address + ":" + port + "/?action=stream";
365  }
366
367  /**
368   * Return URI of sink stream with the given index.
369   *
370   * @param sink Sink index.
371   */
372  private static synchronized String[] getSinkStreamValues(int sink) {
373    // Ignore all but MjpegServer
374    if (VideoSink.getKindFromInt(CameraServerJNI.getSinkKind(sink)) != VideoSink.Kind.MJPEG) {
375      return new String[0];
376    }
377
378    // Get port
379    int port = CameraServerJNI.getMjpegServerPort(sink);
380
381    // Generate values
382    ArrayList<String> values = new ArrayList<>(m_addresses.length + 1);
383    String listenAddress = CameraServerJNI.getMjpegServerListenAddress(sink);
384    if (!listenAddress.isEmpty()) {
385      // If a listen address is specified, only use that
386      values.add(makeStreamValue(listenAddress, port));
387    } else {
388      // Otherwise generate for hostname and all interface addresses
389      values.add(makeStreamValue(CameraServerJNI.getHostname() + ".local", port));
390      for (String addr : m_addresses) {
391        if ("127.0.0.1".equals(addr)) {
392          continue; // ignore localhost
393        }
394        values.add(makeStreamValue(addr, port));
395      }
396    }
397
398    return values.toArray(new String[0]);
399  }
400
401  /**
402   * Return list of stream source URIs for the given source index.
403   *
404   * @param source Source index.
405   */
406  private static synchronized String[] getSourceStreamValues(int source) {
407    // Ignore all but HttpCamera
408    if (VideoSource.getKindFromInt(CameraServerJNI.getSourceKind(source))
409        != VideoSource.Kind.HTTP) {
410      return new String[0];
411    }
412
413    // Generate values
414    String[] values = CameraServerJNI.getHttpCameraUrls(source);
415    for (int j = 0; j < values.length; j++) {
416      values[j] = "mjpg:" + values[j];
417    }
418
419    if (CameraServerSharedStore.getCameraServerShared().isSystemcore()) {
420      // Look to see if we have a passthrough server for this source
421      // Only do this on the Systemcore
422      for (VideoSink i : m_sinks.values()) {
423        int sink = i.getHandle();
424        int sinkSource = CameraServerJNI.getSinkSource(sink);
425        if (source == sinkSource
426            && VideoSink.getKindFromInt(CameraServerJNI.getSinkKind(sink))
427                == VideoSink.Kind.MJPEG) {
428          // Add USB-only passthrough
429          String[] finalValues = Arrays.copyOf(values, values.length + 1);
430          int port = CameraServerJNI.getMjpegServerPort(sink);
431          finalValues[values.length] = makeStreamValue("172.22.11.2", port);
432          return finalValues;
433        }
434      }
435    }
436
437    return values;
438  }
439
440  /** Update list of stream URIs. */
441  private static synchronized void updateStreamValues() {
442    // Over all the sinks...
443    for (VideoSink i : m_sinks.values()) {
444      int sink = i.getHandle();
445
446      // Get the source's subtable (if none exists, we're done)
447      int source =
448          Objects.requireNonNullElseGet(
449              m_fixedSources.get(sink), () -> CameraServerJNI.getSinkSource(sink));
450
451      if (source == 0) {
452        continue;
453      }
454      SourcePublisher publisher = m_publishers.get(source);
455      if (publisher != null) {
456        // Don't set stream values if this is a HttpCamera passthrough
457        if (VideoSource.getKindFromInt(CameraServerJNI.getSourceKind(source))
458            == VideoSource.Kind.HTTP) {
459          continue;
460        }
461
462        // Set table value
463        String[] values = getSinkStreamValues(sink);
464        if (values.length > 0) {
465          publisher.m_streamsPublisher.set(values);
466        }
467      }
468    }
469
470    // Over all the sources...
471    for (VideoSource i : m_sources.values()) {
472      int source = i.getHandle();
473
474      // Get the source's subtable (if none exists, we're done)
475      SourcePublisher publisher = m_publishers.get(source);
476      if (publisher != null) {
477        // Set table value
478        String[] values = getSourceStreamValues(source);
479        if (values.length > 0) {
480          publisher.m_streamsPublisher.set(values);
481        }
482      }
483    }
484  }
485
486  /** Provide string description of pixel format. */
487  private static String pixelFormatToString(PixelFormat pixelFormat) {
488    return switch (pixelFormat) {
489      case MJPEG -> "MJPEG";
490      case YUYV -> "YUYV";
491      case RGB565 -> "RGB565";
492      case BGR -> "BGR";
493      case BGRA -> "BGRA";
494      case GRAY -> "Gray";
495      case Y16 -> "Y16";
496      case UYVY -> "UYVY";
497      case UNKNOWN -> "Unknown";
498    };
499  }
500
501  /**
502   * Provide string description of video mode.
503   *
504   * <p>The returned string is "{width}x{height} {format} {fps} fps".
505   */
506  private static String videoModeToString(VideoMode mode) {
507    return mode.width
508        + "x"
509        + mode.height
510        + " "
511        + pixelFormatToString(mode.pixelFormat)
512        + " "
513        + mode.fps
514        + " fps";
515  }
516
517  /**
518   * Get list of video modes for the given source handle.
519   *
520   * @param sourceHandle Source handle.
521   */
522  private static String[] getSourceModeValues(int sourceHandle) {
523    VideoMode[] modes = CameraServerJNI.enumerateSourceVideoModes(sourceHandle);
524    String[] modeStrings = new String[modes.length];
525    for (int i = 0; i < modes.length; i++) {
526      modeStrings[i] = videoModeToString(modes[i]);
527    }
528    return modeStrings;
529  }

533  /**
534   * Initializes CameraServer integration with WPILib robot code.
535   *
536   * <p>Call this once from robot code before using CameraServer or VisionRunner APIs when using the
537   * CameraServer vendordep. This enables Driver Station error reporting and main robot thread
538   * detection for vision processing helpers.
539   */
540  public static synchronized void initialize() {
541    CameraServerShared shared =
542        new CameraServerShared() {
543          @Override
544          public void reportDriverStationError(String error) {
545            DriverStationErrors.reportError(error, true);
546          }
547
548          @Override
549          public Long getRobotMainThreadId() {
550            return RobotBase.getMainThreadId();
551          }
552
553          @Override
554          public boolean isSystemcore() {
555            return !RobotBase.isSimulation();
556          }
557        };
558
559    CameraServerSharedStore.setCameraServerShared(shared);
560  }

562  /**
563   * Start automatically capturing images to send to the dashboard.
564   *
565   * <p>You should call this method to see a camera feed on the dashboard. If you also want to
566   * perform vision processing on the Systemcore, use getVideo() to get access to the camera images.
567   *
568   * <p>The first time this overload is called, it calls {@link #startAutomaticCapture(int)} with
569   * device 0, creating a camera named "USB Camera 0". Subsequent calls increment the device number
570   * (e.g. 1, 2, etc).
571   *
572   * @return The USB camera capturing images.
573   */
574  public static UsbCamera startAutomaticCapture() {
575    return startAutomaticCapture(m_defaultUsbDevice.getAndIncrement());
576  }
577
578  /**
579   * Start automatically capturing images to send to the dashboard.
580   *
581   * <p>This overload calls {@link #startAutomaticCapture(String, int)} with a name of "USB Camera
582   * {dev}".
583   *
584   * @param dev The device number of the camera interface
585   * @return The USB camera capturing images.
586   */
587  public static UsbCamera startAutomaticCapture(int dev) {
588    UsbCamera camera = new UsbCamera("USB Camera " + dev, dev);
589    startAutomaticCapture(camera);
590    UsageReporting.reportUsage("UsbCamera", dev, "auto");
591    return camera;
592  }

622  /**
623   * Start automatically capturing images to send to the dashboard from an existing camera.
624   *
625   * @param camera Camera
626   * @return The MJPEG server serving images from the given camera.
627   */
628  public static MjpegServer startAutomaticCapture(VideoSource camera) {
629    addCamera(camera);
630    MjpegServer server = addServer("serve_" + camera.getName());
631    server.setSource(camera);
632    return server;

635  /**
636   * Adds a virtual camera for switching between two streams. Unlike the other addCamera methods,
637   * this returns a VideoSink rather than a VideoSource. Calling setSource() on the returned object
638   * can be used to switch the actual source of the stream.
639   *
640   * @param name The name to give the camera
641   * @return The MJPEG server serving images from the given camera.
642   */
643  public static MjpegServer addSwitchedCamera(String name) {
644    // create a dummy CvSource
645    CvSource source = new CvSource(name, PixelFormat.MJPEG, 160, 120, 30);
646    MjpegServer server = startAutomaticCapture(source);
647    synchronized (CameraServer.class) {
648      m_fixedSources.put(server.getHandle(), source.getHandle());
649    }
650
651    return server;
652  }
653
654  /**
655   * Get OpenCV access to the primary camera feed. This allows you to get images from the camera for
656   * image processing on the Systemcore.
657   *
658   * <p>This is only valid to call after a camera feed has been added with startAutomaticCapture()
659   * or addServer().
660   *
661   * @return OpenCV sink for the primary camera feed
662   */
663  public static CvSink getVideo() {
664    VideoSource source;
665    synchronized (CameraServer.class) {
666      if (m_primarySourceName == null) {
667        throw new VideoException("no camera available");
668      }
669      source = m_sources.get(m_primarySourceName);
670    }
671    if (source == null) {
672      throw new VideoException("no camera available");
673    }
674    return getVideo(source);
675  }
676
677  /**
678   * Get OpenCV access to the specified camera. This allows you to get images from the camera for
679   * image processing on the Systemcore.
680   *
681   * @param camera Camera (e.g. as returned by startAutomaticCapture).
682   * @return OpenCV sink for the specified camera
683   */
684  public static CvSink getVideo(VideoSource camera) {
685    String name = "opencv_" + camera.getName();
686
687    synchronized (CameraServer.class) {
688      VideoSink sink = m_sinks.get(name);
689      if (sink != null) {
690        VideoSink.Kind kind = sink.getKind();
691        if (kind != VideoSink.Kind.CV) {
692          throw new VideoException("expected OpenCV sink, but got " + kind);
693        }
694        return (CvSink) sink;
695      }
696    }
697
698    CvSink newsink = new CvSink(name);
699    newsink.setSource(camera);
700    addServer(newsink);
701    return newsink;
702  }
703
704  /**
705   * Get OpenCV access to the specified camera. This allows you to get images from the camera for
706   * image processing on the Systemcore.
707   *
708   * @param camera Camera (e.g. as returned by startAutomaticCapture).
709   * @param pixelFormat Desired pixelFormat of the camera
710   * @return OpenCV sink for the specified camera
711   */
712  public static CvSink getVideo(VideoSource camera, PixelFormat pixelFormat) {
713    String name = "opencv_" + camera.getName();
714
715    synchronized (CameraServer.class) {
716      VideoSink sink = m_sinks.get(name);
717      if (sink != null) {
718        VideoSink.Kind kind = sink.getKind();
719        if (kind != VideoSink.Kind.CV) {
720          throw new VideoException("expected OpenCV sink, but got " + kind);
721        }
722        return (CvSink) sink;
723      }
724    }
725
726    CvSink newsink = new CvSink(name, pixelFormat);
727    newsink.setSource(camera);
728    addServer(newsink);
729    return newsink;
730  }
731
732  /**
733   * Get OpenCV access to the specified camera. This allows you to get images from the camera for
734   * image processing on the Systemcore.
735   *
736   * @param name Camera name
737   * @return OpenCV sink for the specified camera
738   */
739  public static CvSink getVideo(String name) {
740    VideoSource source;
741    synchronized (CameraServer.class) {
742      source = m_sources.get(name);
743      if (source == null) {
744        throw new VideoException("could not find camera " + name);
745      }
746    }
747    return getVideo(source);
748  }

750  /**
751   * Create a MJPEG stream with OpenCV input. This can be called to pass custom annotated images to
752   * the dashboard.
753   *
754   * @param name Name to give the stream
755   * @param width Width of the image being sent
756   * @param height Height of the image being sent
757   * @return OpenCV source for the MJPEG stream
758   */
759  public static CvSource putVideo(String name, int width, int height) {
760    CvSource source = new CvSource(name, PixelFormat.MJPEG, width, height, 30);
761    startAutomaticCapture(source);
762    return source;
763  }

765  /**
766   * Adds a MJPEG server at the next available port.
767   *
768   * @param name Server name
769   * @return The MJPEG server
770   */
771  public static MjpegServer addServer(String name) {
772    int port;
773    synchronized (CameraServer.class) {
774      port = m_nextPort;
775      m_nextPort++;
776    }
777    return addServer(name, port);
778  }

780  /**
781   * Adds a MJPEG server.
782   *
783   * @param name Server name
784   * @param port Server port
785   * @return The MJPEG server
786   */
787  public static MjpegServer addServer(String name, int port) {
788    MjpegServer server = new MjpegServer(name, port);
789    addServer(server);
790    return server;

815  /**
816   * Get server for the primary camera feed.
817   *
818   * <p>This is only valid to call after a camera feed has been added with startAutomaticCapture()
819   * or addServer().
820   *
821   * @return The server for the primary camera feed
822   */
823  public static VideoSink getServer() {
824    synchronized (CameraServer.class) {
825      if (m_primarySourceName == null) {
826        throw new VideoException("no camera available");
827      }
828      return getServer("serve_" + m_primarySourceName);
829    }
830  }

844  /**
845   * Adds an already created camera.
846   *
847   * @param camera Camera
848   */
849  public static void addCamera(VideoSource camera) {
850    String name = camera.getName();
851    synchronized (CameraServer.class) {
852      if (m_primarySourceName == null) {
853        m_primarySourceName = name;
854      }
855      m_sources.put(name, camera);
856    }
857  }
